GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Notification to SAS for Closed Won Opportunities

templateVersions.content:
Write an informal congratulatory email to the entire SAS Team regarding the successful closing of {!$Input:Opportunity.Name}. Be sure to mention the Opportunity Team ({!$Input:Opportunity.Opportunity_Team__c}) and the value of the deal (${!$Input:Opportunity.Amount}). Ensure the messaging is personable and thanks everyone for their hard work in closing the deal.
Do not include a subject.

Ensure the messaging is personable and thanks everyone for their hard work in closing the deal.
Do not include a subject. Be sure to format the amount field to include a comma, if applicable.

Ensure the messaging is personable and thanks everyone for their hard work in closing the deal.
Do not include a subject. Be sure to format the amount field to include a comma, if applicable.
